title: Hearty Crisp Australian Sausage Toast
description: A fermented, crisp, and savory Australian dish featuring sausage and toast, perfect for a midnight craving, this recipe is low-fat-friendly and delicious.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Slice the Australian sausage links into 1/2 inch thick rounds.
Place the sausage rounds on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle the olive oil over the sausage rounds and sprinkle with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and paprika.
Bake the sausage in the preheated oven for 15 minutes, or until crispy and golden brown.
Meanwhile, toast the whole wheat bread slices until crispy and golden brown.
Assemble the snack by placing the baked sausage rounds on top of the toasted bread slices.
Sprinkle the grated cheddar cheese over the sausage rounds.
Return the assembled snack to the oven and bake for an additional 2 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
